title: 一詞多義 (Polysemy) 練習

senses.zh: 留在；待在；暫時不要離開
senses.sourceMeaning: To remain in the same place temporarily and not move away.

questions.en: Please stay in the lobby until staff arrive.
questions.zh: 請留在大堂，直到職員到達。

questions.en: Stay calm during the alarm.
questions.zh: 警鐘響起時請保持冷靜。

questions.en: She stayed at a hotel nearby.
Stay where you are until the route is clear.
questions.zh: 請留在原位，直到路線暢通。

questions.en: The door should stay closed.
The visitor stayed with relatives.
Please stay where you are for the moment.

senses.sourceMeaning: Not panicking; emotionally controlled during an emergency.

questions.en: Please remain calm and follow instructions.
questions.zh: 請保持冷靜並跟從指示。

questions.en: The lobby was calm after the alarm stopped.
questions.zh: 警鐘停止後，大堂變得平靜。

questions.en: Clear instructions can calm visitors.
questions.zh: 清楚指示可以安撫訪客。

questions.en: The guard used a calm voice.
The area became calm again.
The guard tried to calm the passenger.
Please stay calm and follow my instructions.
questions.zh: 請保持冷靜，並跟從我的指示。

senses.zh: 受影響的；受波及的；出現問題的
senses.sourceMeaning: Impacted by a problem, danger, emergency, or incident.

questions.en: The affected floor is closed temporarily.
The alarm affected normal registration.
The passenger was affected by the entrapment.
questions.zh: 乘客因困人事件受影響。

questions.en: Keep away from the affected section.
The power failure affected the lights.
Several visitors were affected by the incident.
Please keep away from the affected area.

senses.sourceMeaning: A part, section, or place inside or around a building.

questions.en: The area near the lift lobby is closed.
questions.zh: 升降機大堂附近區域已關閉。

questions.en: Safety is an important area of training.
questions.zh: 安全是培訓的重要範疇。

questions.en: The wet area covered several square metres.
questions.zh: 濕滑範圍覆蓋數平方米。

questions.en: Please keep the area clear.
Visitor control is part of your work area.
questions.zh: 訪客管制是您的工作範疇之一。

questions.en: The lobby area is large.
Please keep away from the affected area.

senses.zh: 安全的；沒有危險的；可安全使用的
senses.sourceMeaning: Not dangerous; suitable to use during an emergency.

questions.en: Move to a safe area if instructed.
questions.zh: 如有指示，請移到安全區域。

questions.en: The passengers are safe inside the lift.
questions.zh: 乘客在升降機內是安全的。

questions.en: The keys are kept in the safe.
It is not safe to return yet.
Everyone is safe after evacuation.
Documents are locked in the office safe.
questions.zh: 文件鎖在辦公室保險箱內。

questions.en: Please use the nearest safe staircase.
questions.zh: 請使用最近的安全樓梯。

senses.sourceMeaning: A set of stairs inside a building used to move between floors, especially during evacuation.

questions.en: Follow the signs to the emergency staircase.
questions.zh: 請依照標示前往緊急疏散樓梯。

questions.en: The main staircase is in the lobby.
Smoke was reported in the staircase.
Do not block the fire staircase.
The hotel has a wide staircase.
Keep the staircase door closed.
Please use the nearest safe staircase. Do not use the lift.
questions.zh: 請使用最近的安全樓梯，切勿使用升降機。

senses.sourceMeaning: An elevator; a machine that carries people between floors.

questions.en: Please do not lift the barrier manually.
He gave me a lift to the station.
The restriction was lifted after inspection.
Two workers lifted the box carefully.
questions.zh: 兩名工人小心抬起箱子。

questions.en: Can I get a lift to the office?
The alarm was lifted after the all-clear.
Please use the nearest safe staircase. Do not use the lift.
questions.zh: 請使用最近的安全樓梯，切勿使用升降機。

senses.sourceMeaning: To obey or act according to signs, directions, rules, or instructions.

questions.en: Please follow me to the staircase.
Further instructions will follow.
Do you follow what I am saying?
The visitor followed the staff outside.
A short update will follow.
The caller could not follow the directions.
Please follow the evacuation signs and staff instructions.
questions.zh: 請依照疏散指示及職員指示。

senses.sourceMeaning: Written or visual notices that show people where to go or what to do during evacuation.

questions.en: A burning smell can be a sign of danger.
questions.zh: 燒焦味可能是危險跡象。

questions.en: Staff gave a sign to stop.
Please sign the visitor log.
Check for signs of breathing.
questions.zh: 請檢查是否有呼吸跡象。

questions.en: The guard made a sign for visitors to wait.
The tenant signed the incident report.
Please follow the evacuation signs and staff instructions.
questions.zh: 請跟從疏散標示和職員指示。

senses.sourceMeaning: A path or way that people use to enter, leave, or reach someone.

questions.en: Follow the evacuation route to the assembly area.
questions.zh: 請沿疏散路線前往集合地點。

questions.en: Which route should I take to the main entrance?
questions.zh: 我應該走哪條路去正門？

questions.en: The call was routed to the control room.
Staff will guide you along the safe route.
questions.zh: 職員會沿安全路線引導您。

questions.en: This route goes through the car park.
questions.zh: 這條路線會經過停車場。

questions.en: The report was routed to Facilities.
Please keep the access route clear while help is on the way.
questions.zh: 請保持通道暢通，讓救援人員進入。

senses.sourceMeaning: To use physical strength to try to open or move something.

questions.en: Do not force the visitor to move.
Too much force may damage the door.
The police force arrived quickly.
The alarm forced everyone to evacuate.
The door opened with force.
The security force controlled the entrance.
Please remain calm and do not force the doors open.
questions.zh: 請保持冷靜，切勿強行打開升降機門。

senses.sourceMeaning: Precise and specific; not vague or general.

senses.zh: 完全相同的；一模一樣的

questions.en: We need the exact lift number.
questions.zh: 我們需要準確的升降機編號。

questions.en: Please repeat the exact message.
questions.zh: 請覆述完全相同的訊息。

questions.en: The job exacts careful attention.
questions.zh: 這份工作要求高度專注。

questions.en: The exact time was 3:15 p.m.
questions.zh: 準確時間是下午三時十五分。

questions.en: The two reports used the exact same wording.
questions.zh: 兩份報告用詞完全相同。

questions.en: Emergency work can exact a lot of energy.
questions.zh: 緊急工作會消耗很多精力。

questions.en: May I confirm the exact floor, suite, lift number or area?
questions.zh: 可以請您確認確切的樓層、單位、升降機編號或區域嗎？

senses.zh: 團隊；小組；負責處理的人員
senses.sourceMeaning: A group of people responsible for handling a situation, emergency, or building matter.

questions.en: The security team handled the alarm.
Our team won the match.
Staff teamed up to guide visitors.
The Facilities team checked the lift.
questions.zh: 設施團隊檢查了升降機。

questions.en: The football team arrived early.
Security teamed with management.
I’m contacting the emergency / management team now.
questions.zh: 我現在聯絡緊急支援／管理團隊。

senses.sourceMeaning: Given or supplied information to someone.

questions.en: Staff provided assistance at the lobby.
You may proceed provided that it is safe.
CCTV provided useful evidence.
questions.zh: 閉路電視提供有用證據。

questions.en: The building provides emergency support.
Enter provided that access is confirmed.
questions.zh: 只要進入權限已確認，您可以進入。

questions.en: The report provided proof of the fault.
I’ll give them your exact location and the information you have provided.
questions.zh: 我會向他們提供您的確切位置和您已提供的資料。

senses.zh: 清醒的；有意識的；有知覺的
senses.sourceMeaning: Awake, aware, and able to respond to surroundings.

questions.en: Staff should be conscious of safety risks.
questions.zh: 職員應意識到安全風險。

questions.en: The guard made a conscious effort to stay calm.
questions.zh: 保安刻意努力保持冷靜。

questions.en: The team is safety-conscious.
Be conscious of people nearby.
It was a conscious decision not to guess.
questions.zh: 不猜測是有意識的決定。

questions.en: The building is security-conscious.
Is the person conscious and breathing?
questions.zh: 傷者是否清醒及有呼吸？

senses.sourceMeaning: Taking air into and out of the body.

questions.en: Are they breathing normally?
Take a moment to breathe before explaining.
This mask allows you to breathe easily.
questions.zh: 這個口罩讓您較容易呼吸。

questions.en: Tell me if breathing changes.
questions.zh: 如果呼吸有變化，請告訴我。

questions.en: The guard paused to breathe.
The room needs space to breathe.
Is the person conscious and breathing?
questions.zh: 傷者是否清醒及有呼吸？

senses.sourceMeaning: A warning sound or system that alerts people to danger, especially fire or emergency.

questions.en: The alarm system is being checked.
The loud noise caused alarm.
My alarm goes off at 6 a.m.
The door alarm activated.
There is no need for alarm if you follow instructions.
I set an alarm for the briefing.
The fire alarm is sounding.

senses.zh: 響起；發出聲音；正在鳴響
senses.sourceMeaning: Making a sound or noise, especially a warning sound.

questions.en: That sounds urgent.
The structure was found to be sound.
questions.zh: 結構經檢查後確認良好。

questions.en: That is sound advice.
The caller sounded nervous.
The equipment is sound after inspection.
A sound procedure helps staff respond.
questions.zh: 可靠程序有助職員應對。

questions.en: The fire alarm is sounding.

senses.sourceMeaning: To go back to a place where you were before.

questions.en: Please return the visitor pass.
The office returned my call.
The smell returned after a few minutes.
questions.zh: 幾分鐘後氣味再次出現。

questions.en: He returned the access card.
Management returned our message.
questions.zh: 管理層回覆了我們的訊息。

questions.en: The fault returned after reset.
Please do not return to the affected floor.
questions.zh: 請不要返回受影響樓層。

senses.zh: 指定的；指定安排的；獲指派的
senses.sourceMeaning: Officially chosen, assigned, or named for a particular purpose.

questions.en: The designated staff member will guide visitors.
Please wait in the designated area.
Please contact the designated person.
Use the designated entrance for deliveries.
Park only in the designated spaces.
The tenant gave a designated emergency contact.
questions.zh: 租戶提供了指定緊急聯絡人。

questions.en: Please proceed to the designated assembly area as directed by staff.
questions.zh: 請依照職員指示前往指定集合地點。

senses.zh: 集合地點；集合區；疏散集合處
senses.sourceMeaning: A place where people gather after evacuation.

questions.en: The assembly waited outside the building.
questions.zh: 集合的人群在大廈外等候。

questions.en: The school assembly started at 8 a.m.
The assembly of the new barrier took two hours.
questions.zh: 新閘機的組裝用了兩小時。

questions.en: The staff assembly moved to a safer place.
questions.zh: 職員集合隊伍移到較安全地方。

questions.en: Students attended assembly in the hall.
Equipment assembly must follow the manual.
questions.zh: 設備組裝必須按照手冊。

questions.en: Please proceed to the designated assembly area as directed by staff.
questions.zh: 請依照職員指示前往指定集合地點。

senses.zh: 安全確認；解除警報；可恢復進入的通知
senses.sourceMeaning: An official signal or confirmation that danger has passed and it is safe to return or continue.

questions.en: The all-clear was given after inspection.
questions.zh: 檢查後發出危險解除信號。

questions.en: Give clear instructions during evacuation.
questions.zh: 疏散期間給出清楚指示。

questions.en: Keep the access route clear.
Visitors waited until the all-clear.
The announcement was clear.
The staircase must remain clear.
Re-entry can only be confirmed after the authorised team gives the all-clear.
questions.zh: 必須等授權團隊確認安全後，才可以重新進入。

senses.zh: 緊急的；迫切的；急需處理的

questions.en: Report urgent issues immediately.
There is an urgent need to keep the route clear.
I received an urgent message from the tenant.
questions.zh: 我收到租戶的緊急訊息。

questions.en: The tenant made an urgent request.
The injured person has an urgent need for help.
Send urgent updates to management.
questions.zh: 把緊急更新發給管理層。

questions.en: We need urgent help.

senses.sourceMeaning: Fell down suddenly because of illness, weakness, injury, or loss of consciousness.

questions.en: Part of the ceiling collapsed after the leak.
The visitor system collapsed during peak time.
questions.zh: 訪客系統在繁忙時間癱瘓。

questions.en: The company collapsed after financial problems.
The old wall collapsed during repairs.
The network collapsed after the power failure.
The project collapsed due to lack of support.
questions.zh: 項目因缺乏支援而告吹。

questions.en: One of my colleagues has collapsed near the lift lobby.
questions.zh: 我的一位同事在升降機大堂附近暈倒了。

senses.zh: 大堂；升降機大堂；等候區
senses.sourceMeaning: An open area near the lifts where people wait or pass through.

questions.en: Please wait in the main lobby.
The business lobby supported the proposal.
questions.zh: 商界游說團體支持建議。

questions.en: Residents lobbied for better safety measures.
questions.zh: 居民游說爭取更好安全措施。

questions.en: The visitor is standing in the lobby.
The environmental lobby opposed the plan.
questions.zh: 環保游說團體反對計劃。

questions.en: The group lobbied management.
One of my colleagues has collapsed near the lift lobby.
questions.zh: 我的一位同事在升降機大堂附近暈倒了。

senses.sourceMeaning: Not asleep; conscious enough to show signs of awareness.

questions.en: He awoke after a few minutes.
Staff must be awake to safety risks.
questions.zh: 職員必須意識到安全風險。

questions.en: Try to stay awake while help is on the way.
questions.zh: 救援前來時請盡量保持清醒。

questions.en: Tell me immediately if the person wakes up.
questions.zh: 如果那個人醒過來，請立即告訴我。

questions.en: Be awake to changes in condition.
Please stay awake and keep talking.
questions.zh: 請保持清醒並繼續說話。

questions.en: Is the person awake and breathing?
questions.zh: 那個人是否清醒？是否有呼吸？

senses.zh: 沒有反應；無反應；叫喚沒有回應
senses.sourceMeaning: Not reacting, answering, or responding to people.

questions.en: The office has been unresponsive today.
questions.zh: 辦公室今天一直沒有回覆。

questions.en: The lift panel is unresponsive.
The person became responsive after a few minutes.
questions.zh: 幾分鐘後那個人有反應了。

questions.en: The tenant was unresponsive to our message.
questions.zh: 租戶沒有回覆我們的訊息。

questions.en: The reader became unresponsive after the scan.
questions.zh: 掃描後讀卡器變得沒有反應。

questions.en: The system is responsive again.
He is breathing, but he is unresponsive.

senses.sourceMeaning: Help or support, especially from an emergency, security, or management team.

questions.en: Please ask staff for assistance.
Security requested assistance from management.
questions.zh: 保安向管理層要求支援。

questions.en: We need technical assistance for the lift panel.
questions.zh: 我們需要升降機面板的技術支援。

questions.en: We are here to provide assistance.
Facilities provided assistance with the lift issue.
questions.zh: 設施部協助處理升降機問題。

questions.en: Technical assistance was requested for the alarm system.
questions.zh: 已要求警報系統技術支援。

questions.en: I’m requesting emergency assistance now and will give them your exact location.
questions.zh: 我現在正要求緊急協助，並會向他們提供您的確切位置。

senses.sourceMeaning: To change someone’s position or location.

questions.en: Move to the safe staircase if instructed.
questions.zh: 如有指示，請移到安全樓梯。

questions.en: The tenant moved to another floor.
The visitor was moved by the staff’s help.
questions.zh: 訪客被職員的幫助感動。

questions.en: Please move away from the affected area.
Our office will move next month.
Her calm response moved the caller.
questions.zh: 她冷靜的回應感動了來電者。

questions.en: Please do not move him unless there is immediate danger.
questions.zh: 除非有即時危險，否則請不要移動他。

senses.sourceMeaning: Happening now or needing action now; not delayed.

questions.en: Please report any immediate risk.
Use the immediate exit if directed.
questions.zh: 如有指示，請使用最近出口。

questions.en: The immediate cause was the blocked route.
We need immediate assistance.
Keep the immediate area clear.
The immediate response was to call for help.
Please do not move him unless there is immediate danger.
questions.zh: 除非有即時危險，否則請不要移動他。

senses.sourceMeaning: A situation that may cause harm, injury, or serious risk.

questions.en: There is a danger of slipping on the wet floor.
The exposed wire is a danger to visitors.
questions.zh: 外露電線對訪客構成危險。

questions.en: The person is not out of danger yet.
There is a danger of panic during an alarm.
questions.zh: 警鐘期間有恐慌的風險。

questions.en: A blocked exit is a serious danger.
Wait until everyone is out of danger.
questions.zh: 請等到所有人脫離危險。

questions.en: Please do not move him unless there is immediate danger.
questions.zh: 除非有即時危險，否則請不要移動他。

senses.sourceMeaning: To examine a situation and decide how serious it is or what should be done.

questions.en: Management will assess the seriousness of the incident.
questions.zh: 管理層會評估事件嚴重程度。

questions.en: The trainer assessed the role-play performance.
questions.zh: 培訓員評估角色扮演表現。

questions.en: Assess the risk before entering the affected area.
questions.zh: 進入受影響範圍前先評估風險。

questions.en: The team assessed the water leak as urgent.
questions.zh: 團隊評估漏水情況為緊急。

questions.en: Supervisors assess guards during drills.
questions.zh: 主管在演習中評核保安。

questions.en: Facilities assessed the damage to the lift.
questions.zh: 設施部評估升降機損壞。

questions.en: The responding team will assess the situation on arrival.
questions.zh: 應變團隊到場後會評估情況。

senses.sourceMeaning: A person’s physical state, especially in a medical situation.

questions.en: The lift is in poor condition.
Re-entry is allowed only under safe conditions.
questions.zh: 只有在安全條件下才可重新進入。

questions.en: Please read the terms and conditions.
The staircase is in good condition.
Tenant confirmation is a condition for access.
Access is subject to building conditions.
Tell me immediately if his condition changes.
questions.zh: 如果他的情況有變，請立即告訴我。

questions.en: Stop normal registration and begin evacuation.
questions.zh: 停止正常登記並開始疏散。

questions.en: Staff stopped visitors from entering the affected area.
questions.zh: 職員阻止訪客進入受影響範圍。

questions.en: The bus stop is outside the building.
Please stop using the lift during the alarm.
questions.zh: 警鐘期間請停止使用升降機。

questions.en: The barrier stopped cars from leaving.
The shuttle stop is near the main entrance.
questions.zh: 穿梭巴士站在正門附近。

questions.en: The lift has stopped and the doors will not open.
questions.zh: 升降機停住了，門打不開。

senses.sourceMeaning: The enclosed part of a lift/elevator that carries people between floors.

questions.en: A car is blocking the exit lane.
Passengers moved to the next car.
Several cars are waiting at the barrier.
questions.zh: 幾輛車正在閘機前等候。

questions.en: Please do not park your car here.
The dining car is at the end of the train.
Cars can still exit via Lane 1.
questions.zh: 車輛仍可經 1 號線離開。

questions.en: The car has stopped between floors and the doors are not opening.
questions.zh: 升降機轎廂停在樓層之間，門沒有打開。

senses.sourceMeaning: In the space separating two places, levels, or things.

questions.en: The staircase is between the lift lobby and the pantry.
questions.zh: 樓梯在升降機大堂和茶水間之間。

questions.en: The passengers shared one phone between them.
The incident happened between 3:00 and 3:10 p.m.
questions.zh: 事件發生在下午三時至三時十分之間。

questions.en: The corridor is between two office areas.
questions.zh: 走廊在兩個辦公區域之間。

questions.en: Divide the task between security and management.
questions.zh: 把任務分配給保安和管理層。

questions.en: Please wait between updates.
The car has stopped between floors and the doors are not opening.
questions.zh: 升降機轎廂停在樓層之間，門沒有打開。

senses.zh: 在裡面；在內；在升降機內
senses.sourceMeaning: In the lift car; within the enclosed space.

questions.en: Visitors waited inside the lobby before evacuation.
questions.zh: 疏散前訪客在大堂內等候。

questions.en: The team arrived inside ten minutes.
Do not share inside information.
Please stay inside until directed.
questions.zh: 請留在室內，直到有指示。

questions.en: Update us inside five minutes if anything changes.
questions.zh: 如有變化，請在五分鐘內更新我們。

questions.en: Only authorised staff know the inside details.
questions.zh: 只有授權職員知道內情。

questions.en: How many people are inside?
My arm hurts after the fall.
The angry words hurt the visitor.
questions.zh: 憤怒的說話傷害了訪客。

questions.en: Poor communication can hurt trust.
Tell me where it hurts.
He felt hurt after the complaint.
Delays hurt service quality.
Is anyone hurt or feeling unwell?
questions.zh: 有沒有人受傷或感到不適？

senses.sourceMeaning: Worried, frightened, or uneasy because of the lift entrapment.

questions.en: The passenger is anxious about the lift doors.
The new guard felt nervous during the role-play.
questions.zh: 新保安在角色扮演時緊張。

questions.en: The tenant was anxious to get an update.
Visitors became nervous during the alarm.
questions.zh: 警鐘期間訪客變得緊張。

questions.en: Students are often anxious before an exam.
The visitor was anxious to leave.
No one is hurt, but one person is very nervous.
questions.zh: 沒有人受傷，但有一個人非常緊張。

senses.sourceMeaning: To try to do something, especially something difficult or unsafe.

questions.en: This is your first attempt at the report.
questions.zh: 這是你第一次嘗試寫報告。

questions.en: We attempted to contact management.
It was an attempted unauthorised entry.
questions.zh: 這是企圖未經授權進入。

questions.en: The first attempt to contact the tenant failed.
questions.zh: 第一次嘗試聯絡租戶失敗。

questions.en: Please record each attempt to call the office.
questions.zh: 請記錄每次致電辦公室的嘗試。

questions.en: The report mentioned an attempted door opening.
questions.zh: 報告提到有人企圖開門。

questions.en: Please remain inside and do not attempt to force the doors open.
questions.zh: 請留在升降機內，不要嘗試強行打開門。

senses.sourceMeaning: A situation where people are trapped inside a lift and cannot get out safely by themselves.

questions.en: The worker faced entrapment in the service room.
questions.zh: 工人在服務房內面臨被困。

questions.en: Machinery entrapment is a serious risk.
The lawyer discussed police entrapment.
Avoid areas with entrapment risk.
questions.zh: 避開有被困風險的區域。

questions.en: Keep hands away from moving parts.
Entrapment can be a legal issue.
I’m reporting the entrapment for urgent assistance now.
questions.zh: 我現在會匯報升降機困人事件，要求緊急協助。

senses.zh: 解困；被放出；恢復可離開
senses.sourceMeaning: Freed from being stuck or trapped, so passengers can leave the lift safely.

questions.en: The person was released after questioning.
Management released an update.
Release the button after the light turns green.
Security released the visitor after confirmation.
questions.zh: 確認後保安讓訪客離開。

questions.en: The report was released yesterday.
Do not release the door until safe.
Can you tell us when the lift will be released?
questions.zh: 你可以告訴我們甚麼時候可以被放出來嗎？

senses.zh: 掛線；掛斷電話；中斷通話
senses.sourceMeaning: To end a phone or intercom call.

questions.en: Hang the notice near the lift lobby.
questions.zh: 把告示掛在升降機大堂附近。

questions.en: Please hang on while I check.
Do not get hung up on one detail.
Please hang your coat in the staff room.
Hang on; help is being arranged.
questions.zh: 請不要掛線，正在安排支援。

questions.en: He was hung up on the earlier mistake.
questions.zh: 他一直放不下之前的錯誤。

questions.en: Please don’t hang up.

senses.sourceMeaning: To continue keeping something in place; to keep contact without stopping.

questions.en: Facilities maintains the lift system.
questions.zh: 設施部保養升降機系統。

questions.en: Maintain a calm tone during the call.
questions.zh: 通話期間保持冷靜語氣。

questions.en: The tenant maintained that the person was still in the corridor.
questions.zh: 租戶堅稱該人士仍在走廊。

questions.en: The building must maintain emergency equipment.
questions.zh: 大廈必須維護緊急設備。

questions.en: Staff maintained clear communication.
He maintained that he had reported the incident.
Yes. I’ll maintain contact.

senses.sourceMeaning: Becomes different from before, especially in a way that may affect safety.

questions.en: We may need to change the route.
questions.zh: 我們可能需要更改路線。

questions.en: Change the damaged sign.
The cashier gave me the wrong change.
Management changed the evacuation instruction.
questions.zh: 管理層更改了疏散指示。

questions.en: The technician changed the faulty part.
questions.zh: 技術員更換了故障零件。

questions.en: Do you have any change?
Please tell me immediately if anyone becomes unwell or if the situation changes.
questions.zh: 如果有人感到不適，或情況有任何變化，請立即告訴我。

senses.zh: 可疑的；令人懷疑的；有問題的
senses.sourceMeaning: Making people think something may be wrong, unsafe, or not allowed.

questions.en: The tenant was suspicious of the stranger.
A suspicious smell was reported near the lobby.
questions.zh: 有人報告大堂附近有異常氣味。

questions.en: Do not touch a suspicious package.
Staff became suspicious after repeated access attempts.
questions.zh: 多次嘗試進入後，職員開始起疑。

questions.en: The sound seemed suspicious.
Keep people away from suspicious objects.
Suspicious Person in a Restricted Area
questions.zh: 受管制區域內有可疑人士。

senses.zh: 受限制的；受管制的；只限授權人士的
senses.sourceMeaning: Limited to authorised people only; not open to everyone.

questions.en: Access is restricted during the alarm.
Do not share restricted information.
Staff may restrict movement during evacuation.
questions.zh: 疏散期間職員可能限制人員移動。

questions.en: Parking is restricted to authorised vehicles.
Medical details may be restricted information.
questions.zh: 醫療詳情可能屬受限制資料。

questions.en: The blocked corridor restricted movement.
questions.zh: 走廊受阻限制了人員移動。

questions.en: Suspicious Person in a Restricted Area
questions.zh: 限制區域內的可疑人士。

senses.sourceMeaning: To know someone because you have seen or met them before.

questions.en: Please describe the person so staff can recognise him.
questions.zh: 請描述該人士，好讓職員識別他。

questions.en: The company recognised the new procedure.
The supervisor recognised the team’s good work.
questions.zh: 主管表揚團隊良好工作。

questions.en: The system failed to recognise the access card.
The qualification is recognised by management.
Management recognised staff for calm handling.
questions.zh: 管理層肯定職員冷靜處理事件。

questions.en: There is someone I don’t recognise near the corridor.
questions.zh: 走廊附近有一個我不認得的人。

senses.sourceMeaning: A long passage inside a building that connects rooms, offices, lift lobbies, or service areas.

questions.en: The person is near the rear service corridor.
questions.zh: 該人士在後方服務走廊附近。

questions.en: The rail corridor is closed for repairs.
The park created a wildlife corridor.
questions.zh: 公園建立了野生動物通道。

questions.en: Visitors should not enter the service corridor.
questions.zh: 訪客不應進入服務走廊。

questions.en: This road is an important transport corridor.
questions.zh: 這條路是重要交通走廊。

questions.en: The corridor allows animals to move safely.
questions.zh: 該通道讓動物安全移動。

questions.en: There is someone I don’t recognise near the corridor.
questions.zh: 走廊附近有一個我不認得的人。

senses.sourceMeaning: Attempting to open or use something, especially in a way that looks suspicious.

questions.en: Try another access card if instructed.
questions.zh: 如有指示，請試另一張門禁卡。

questions.en: Please try to stay calm.
Lift entrapment can be a trying experience.
questions.zh: 升降機困人可能是難熬的經歷。

questions.en: The technician tried the lift panel.
questions.zh: 技術員測試了升降機面板。

questions.en: Staff tried to keep the route clear.
questions.zh: 職員努力保持通道暢通。

questions.en: It was a trying day for the team.
questions.zh: 那天對團隊來說很難熬。

questions.en: He keeps trying different doors.
questions.zh: 他一直在試開不同的門。

senses.sourceMeaning: The part of a door that you hold, turn, or pull to open it.

questions.en: The guard handled the emergency calmly.
questions.zh: 保安冷靜處理緊急情況。

questions.en: Do not handle the suspicious object.
The team has a handle on the situation.
Management will handle the complaint.
Staff handled the equipment carefully.
We need facts before we have a handle on it.
questions.zh: 我們需要事實才能掌握情況。

questions.en: He is still trying door handles.

senses.sourceMeaning: To see, notice, or watch facts directly.

questions.en: Continue to observe from a safe distance.
questions.zh: 請繼續從安全距離觀察。

questions.en: Visitors must observe building rules.
questions.zh: 訪客必須遵守大廈規則。

questions.en: The supervisor observed that the report was clear.
Security observed the corridor through CCTV.
questions.zh: 保安透過閉路電視監察走廊。

questions.en: Staff observed emergency procedures.
She observed that more training was needed.
Could you describe only what you can observe -what the person is doing, their clothing, and where they are standing?
questions.zh: 請只描述您能觀察到的事情。

senses.sourceMeaning: Being on one’s feet in a particular place.

questions.en: The instruction still stands.
G/F stands for ground floor.
Please stand by for further instructions.
questions.zh: 請待命等候進一步指示。

questions.en: The evacuation order stands until the all-clear.
questions.zh: 疏散命令在安全確認前仍有效。

questions.en: CS stands for Customer Service.
Security is standing by near the lobby.
questions.zh: 保安正在大堂附近待命。

questions.en: Could you describe only what you can observe -what the person is doing, their clothing, and where they are standing?
questions.zh: 請說明他站在甚麼位置。

senses.sourceMeaning: To go near or move closer to someone.

questions.en: Approach reception if you need help.
A calm approach helps in emergencies.
questions.zh: 冷靜的處理方式有助應急。

questions.en: The deadline is approaching.
The tenant approached security about the person.
questions.zh: 租戶向保安反映該人士。

questions.en: The best approach is to report facts only.
questions.zh: 最佳做法是只匯報事實。

questions.en: As inspection time approached, staff prepared.
questions.zh: 檢查時間臨近時職員準備。

questions.en: Please keep a safe distance and do not approach him.
questions.zh: 請保持安全距離，不要接近他。

senses.zh: 對峙；質問；正面面對對方
senses.sourceMeaning: To face someone directly in a challenging, questioning, or possibly aggressive way.

questions.en: Staff must confront emergencies calmly.
questions.zh: 職員必須冷靜面對緊急情況。

questions.en: We need to confront the safety problem.
questions.zh: 我們需要正視安全問題。

questions.en: Avoid confrontation with suspicious persons.
The team confronted a serious access issue.
questions.zh: 團隊面對嚴重門禁問題。

questions.en: Management confronted the repeated fault.
A confrontation may increase risk.
Please keep a safe distance and do not approach or confront the person.
questions.zh: 請保持安全距離，不要接近或質問該人士。

senses.sourceMeaning: To interact with someone, speak to them, or get involved with them.

questions.en: Clear training engages students.
questions.zh: 清楚培訓能吸引學生投入。

questions.en: Staff engaged in emergency practice.
The building engaged a contractor.
The role-play engaged the whole class.
The team engaged in a safety drill.
Management engaged a lift technician.
questions.zh: 管理層聘請升降機技術員。

questions.en: Please do not engage with him.

senses.zh: 描述；外貌描述；特徵資料
senses.sourceMeaning: Details about what a person looks like, what they are wearing, what they are carrying, and what they are doing.

questions.en: The report included a clear description.
Emergency reporting is in the guard’s job description.
questions.zh: 緊急匯報屬保安職責之一。

questions.en: The person matches the description.
The tenant gave a short description of the incident.
The job description includes visitor control.
questions.zh: 職位描述包括訪客管制。

questions.en: The backpack matches the tenant’s description.
I’ll report the exact location and description to the security / management team immediately.
questions.zh: 我會立刻把確切位置和該人士的特徵資料匯報給保安或管理團隊。

senses.zh: 已通知；已告知；已獲通知
senses.sourceMeaning: Told or notified about the situation.

questions.en: Please inform security immediately.
A well-informed guard can respond clearly.
questions.zh: 了解情況的保安能清楚應對。

questions.en: The supervisor made an informed decision.
Inform the tenant if the situation changes.
questions.zh: 如情況有變，請通知租戶。

questions.en: Keep staff well-informed during emergencies.
questions.zh: 緊急期間要讓職員充分了解情況。

questions.en: Accurate facts support informed decisions.
questions.zh: 準確事實支持知情決定。

questions.en: The responding team has been informed.

senses.zh: 停電；電力故障；電力中斷
senses.sourceMeaning: A loss of electrical power; electricity has stopped working in an area.

questions.en: The lift needs power to operate.
Only authorised staff have the power to give the all-clear.
questions.zh: 只有授權職員有權發出安全確認。

questions.en: Facilities checked the power supply.
Do not touch equipment near water and power.
questions.zh: 不要觸碰靠近水和電源的設備。

questions.en: Security does not have the power to promise re-entry.
questions.zh: 保安無權承諾重新進入。

questions.en: A power outage affected the lights.
Water Leak + Power Failure

senses.sourceMeaning: The inside top surface of a room or corridor.

questions.en: There is a ceiling on overtime hours.
A ceiling panel is loose.
The company discussed the glass ceiling.
questions.zh: 公司討論玻璃天花板問題。

questions.en: The budget ceiling cannot be exceeded.
The ceiling light has gone out.
The glass ceiling limits promotion opportunities.
questions.zh: 玻璃天花板限制晉升機會。

questions.en: Water is coming from the ceiling.
The power has gone out on this floor.
He went out after the meeting.
The emergency message went out to staff.
If the power goes out, follow staff instructions.
questions.zh: 如果停電，請依照職員指示。

questions.en: Staff should not go out through the affected area.
questions.zh: 職員不應經受影響範圍外出。

questions.en: A notice has gone out to tenants.
The lights in the corridor have gone out.

senses.sourceMeaning: An electrical outlet where a plug is inserted.

questions.en: Insert the cable into the correct socket.
The doctor checked the eye socket.
Do not touch a wet light socket.
The network socket is beside the desk.
The dentist cleaned the tooth socket.
The technician used a socket wrench.
A socket is nearby.

senses.sourceMeaning: Cards used to unlock doors or enter controlled areas.

questions.en: Please wear your visitor card visibly.
questions.zh: 請把訪客證佩戴在明顯位置。

questions.en: Please show your ID card.
Tap the access card on the card reader.
questions.zh: 請把門禁卡拍在讀卡器上。

questions.en: Return the visitor card before leaving.
He used a card to pay for parking.
The card reader did not respond.
Unknown person trying several access cards.
questions.zh: 有不明人士在嘗試用多張門禁卡進入。

senses.zh: 具攻擊性的；咄咄逼人的；激動的
senses.sourceMeaning: Angry, forceful, threatening, or behaving in a way that may create risk.

questions.en: Avoid aggressive language at the counter.
Call for help if aggression increases.
questions.zh: 如果攻擊性增加，請求援。

questions.en: The company has an aggressive growth plan.
questions.zh: 公司有進取的增長計劃。

questions.en: A calm boundary is better than an aggressive reply.
questions.zh: 冷靜設界線比強硬回應更好。

questions.en: Keep distance if the person becomes aggressive.
questions.zh: 如果對方變得具攻擊性，請保持距離。

questions.en: An aggressive schedule may pressure staff.
questions.zh: 進取的時間表可能給職員壓力。

questions.en: Aggressive Visitor

senses.sourceMeaning: A controlled entry point that blocks or allows access.

questions.en: The car park gate is not opening.
Please proceed to Gate 12.
questions.zh: 請前往 12 號登機閘口。

questions.en: The delivery arrived at the side gate.
The exit gate remains closed.
The boarding gate closes at 3 p.m.
questions.zh: 登機閘口下午三時關閉。

questions.en: The front gate is locked.
Open the gate now. I’m going upstairs.

senses.sourceMeaning: One part or position beside a boundary, gate, counter, or access point.

questions.en: The staircase is on the left side.
We need to understand the safety side of the issue.
questions.zh: 我們需要了解安全方面。

questions.en: Security should not take sides in a dispute.
questions.zh: 保安不應偏袒任何一方。

questions.en: The service door is on the other side.
From the visitor’s side, the delay is frustrating.
questions.zh: 從訪客角度看，延誤令人沮喪。

questions.en: Staff should side with procedure, not emotion.
Please remain on this side of the access point.
questions.zh: 請留在門禁點這邊，不要越過去。

senses.sourceMeaning: Intense, noticeable, or powerful in smell.

questions.en: Two strong staff moved the barrier.
questions.zh: 兩名強壯職員移開圍欄。

questions.en: The report gave strong evidence.
The radio signal is strong in the lobby.
The door needs a strong push.
Clear facts make a strong report.
questions.zh: 清楚事實形成有力報告。

questions.en: Keep a strong connection on the intercom.
questions.zh: 請保持對講機連線穩定。

questions.en: Another tenant reports a strong burning smell near Lift Lobby B.
questions.zh: 有租戶報告 B 升降機大堂附近有很濃的燒焦味。

senses.sourceMeaning: Smelling like something is on fire, overheated, or being burned.

questions.en: Do not touch hot equipment; it may burn you.
questions.zh: 不要觸碰熱設備，可能會燙傷。

questions.en: She had a burning question about safety.
questions.zh: 她有一個迫切的安全問題。

questions.en: The light bulb burned out.
The worker burned his hand on the panel.
There was a burning need for clear instructions.
There was a burn mark near the socket.
Another tenant reports a strong burning smell near Lift Lobby B.
questions.zh: B 升降機大堂附近有很濃的燒焦味。

senses.sourceMeaning: After the expected or arranged time.

questions.en: The report came late in the afternoon.
questions.zh: 報告在下午較晚時候傳來。

questions.en: It is too late to return to the affected floor.
questions.zh: 現在返回受影響樓層太遲。

questions.en: The late manager set the rule.
The alarm sounded late in the shift.
Do not wait until it is too late.
The late director introduced the policy.
Can I just take the lift? I’m already late.
questions.zh: 我可以直接搭升降機嗎？我已經遲到了。

senses.sourceMeaning: To officially tell or record information about an incident.

questions.en: Complete the incident report after evacuation.
The news report mentioned the power failure.
The guard reports to the supervisor.
The report should include action and status.
questions.zh: 報告應包括行動和狀態。

questions.en: A traffic report said the road was blocked.
Report to management immediately.
I’ll report the exact location and the information received.
questions.zh: 我會匯報確切位置和收到的資料。

senses.sourceMeaning: The current condition, progress, or latest situation of an incident.

questions.en: What is the status of the incident?
The visitor’s access status is not confirmed.
questions.zh: 訪客進入狀態尚未確認。

questions.en: The system status shows power failure.
questions.zh: 系統狀態顯示電力故障。

questions.en: Update me on the status of the lift entrapment.
questions.zh: 請更新升降機困人事件的進度。

questions.en: The contractor’s registration status is pending.
questions.zh: 承辦商登記狀態仍待處理。

questions.en: The alarm panel status must be checked.
questions.zh: 警報面板狀態必須檢查。

questions.en: After evacuation, report: WHAT -WHERE - WHEN - WHO - ACTION -STATUS.
questions.zh: 疏散後，請匯報事情、位置、時間、人物、已採取行動及目前狀況。

sourceNotes: MC labels are transcribed from the PDF's 繁體中文 column; the answer-giving 'Please note' lines are excluded.
